answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the pulse of free entry disappears, the trellis of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the anchor case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get.
